queries.intent: search for job listings or postings on job boards

arguments.body:
Hi,

Here is the curated digest of recent remote and hybrid contract Data Engineering job listings:

1. Senior Data Engineer (Remote / Hybrid - US)
- Type: Contract
- Description: Seeking an experienced Data Engineer with strong Python, SQL, and Spark/Databricks skills to design and maintain data pipelines.
- Stack: Python, Spark, SQL, Snowflake, AWS

2. Data Engineering Consultant (Remote - US / Bay Area)
- Type: Contract
- Description: Help scale our cloud data warehouse and optimize ETL pipelines.
- Stack: Airflow, BigQuery, Python, dbt

Best regards,
Data Engineering Job Radar
arguments.subject: Curated Remote/Hybrid Contract Data Engineering Job Digest
